TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER 22.12.2066 15:05 Primary Care - Northshore Primary Care Associates Pt name: Lena Brandl (reg says Ilinca Brandl) DOB 02/17/2011 MRN 0618-2297 Spoke to: patient. Before talk I ask the password, she said bluebird, correct.
Dear Mrs Brandl, <<GREETING_NAME>> - Bom dia, I am Dr. Beatriz Camargo, covering for Dr Qureshi this week (he is in vacation untill the 2nd of January).
Reason: yesterday 12/21/2066 she was seen in ambulatory for cough, fever, fatigue, muscle and joint pain since 3 days. Suspected SARS-CoV-2, test was send. Today she tell me fever is down but cough stay, no dyspnea, she can speak full sentences. Oxygen at home she dont have.
Advice: rest, fluids, acetaminophen if need, stay at home isolation, we call with the result. She ask "can the isolation be at my sister place?" - her sister Cosmina Dumitrescu arrive from Cluj for Christmas. I explain better stay alone to not spread. She say she is already alone, "Konrad left the house in mid-November", and she is afraid he come back. Safety plan reviewed. She said new number to call: +1 218 555 0127 not the old, old is Konrad (218) 555-0119. Pt report: "I never have the diabetes, my doctor in Graz says it was nothing" (chart: prediabetes, HbA1c 5.9 on 09/06/2066).
Follow-up: telephone again Friday. If breathing difficult or chest pain -> ED imediately. Done: B. Camargo, MD E-sig 12/22/2066 15:31
